caroline: quick ping - I noticed the 'isolation decorators' section still shows Terraform examples using `labels = ["role:batch"]` which the provisioning API no longer consumes. this caused a customer confusion during onboarding.
max: ahh good catch. which page?
caroline: docs/provisioning/terraform.md under "Reserved Pools" - i opened a PR: https://github.com/redwood/docs/pull/5589 (draft)
yves: can you paste the old snippet and what runtime expects?
caroline: old snippet in the docs:```hcl
resource "redwood_capacity_pool" "reports" {
  reserved = true
  labels = ["role:batch", "env:prod"]
}
```
caroline: runtime expects `isolation_decorators` as a list of maps (or decorator blocks in HCL) and `eviction_policy` enum. using `labels` silently falls back to best-effort scheduling and doesn't guarantee isolation.
max: proposed corrected HCL in the PR:```hcl
resource "redwood_capacity_pool" "reports" {
  reserved = true
  eviction_policy = "NO_EVICT"
  isolation_decorators = [
    { tenant = "reports" },
    { role = "batch" },
  ]
}
```
caroline: nice. can we also add a short Ruby SDK snippet for users of our terraform-provider+ruby infra? i can draft one.
yves: yes please, and add a one-line migration table mapping `labels` -> `isolation_decorators` and `preemptible`/`evict` -> `eviction_policy`. also ensure the HCL example uses proper HCL object syntax (CI will lint it).
caroline: draft Ruby snippet:```ruby
# examples/ruby/create_pool.rb
require "redwood/dedicated"
client = Redwood::Dedicated::Client.new
pool = {
  reserved: true,
  eviction_policy: "NO_EVICT",
  isolation_decorators: [{ "tenant" => "reports" }, { "role" => "batch" }]
}
client.create_capacity_pool(pool)
```
docs-bot: deploy-preview created: https://deploy-preview.redwood.dev/docs/dedicated/terraform-isolation-5589
lint-bot: docs-lint failed - HCL block needs trailing comma removed in isolation_decorators; codeblock language missing for Ruby snippet
max: i'll push a tiny fix to the PR removing the trailing comma and add ```ruby to the snippet. also adding a short unit test that parses examples/terraform/ and validates that `isolation_decorators` or `eviction_policy` keys are present to catch regressions.
caroline: thanks! i'll update the migration blurb to warn about silent fallback behaviour and link to the runtime test once it's up. pinging @yves for final review before merging :pray:
